name: Clay
description: Official Clay Public API for GTM people and company searches, enrichment routines, asynchronous batch runs, and Enterprise table queries.

credential_fields.name: api_key
credential_fields.label: Clay API key
credential_fields.description: Personal API key created under Settings > Account in Clay.

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Return the Clay user and workspace associated with the API key. Use this to verify credentials.

tools.name: list_search_fields
tools.description: List every supported structured search filter for people or companies, including types, allowed values, and guidance. Call this before creating a structured search.

tools.name: create_structured_search
tools.description: Create a stateful people or company search using Clay's documented structured filters. Returns a search_id; pass it to run_structured_search to retrieve results.

filters.description: Filter object built from list_search_fields metadata.

tools.name: run_structured_search
tools.description: Return the next page from a structured Clay search. The search is a stateful iterator, so repeat this call with the same search_id for subsequent pages.

tools.name: get_search_query_reference
tools.description: Return Clay's current advanced-search query language reference in Markdown. Use it before composing a beta query-mode search.

tools.name: create_query_search
tools.description: Create a people or company search from Clay's advanced search query language (beta). Returns a search_id.

query.description: Clay search query written using get_search_query_reference.

tools.name: run_query_search
tools.description: Return the next page from a beta query-mode Clay search. Repeat with the same search_id to advance the iterator.

tools.name: run_routine
tools.description: Execute a Clay-managed or custom routine against 1-100 records. Returns a routine_run_id for asynchronous result polling.

webhook_id.description: Optional registered Clay webhook notified on completion.

tools.name: get_routine_results
tools.description: Fetch status and a page of results for an asynchronous routine run.

tools.name: create_batch_upload_url
tools.description: Issue a presigned PUT URL and file_id for uploading a JSONL input file for a large routine batch.

tools.name: start_batch_routine
tools.description: Start an asynchronous routine batch after uploading JSONL to the presigned URL returned by create_batch_upload_url.

tools.name: get_batch_results
tools.description: Fetch progress and results for an asynchronous routine batch.

tools.name: query_tables
tools.description: Run a structured query across known Clay tables (Enterprise only). Supports selected fields, filters, joins, grouping, ordering, and cursor pagination.

query.description: Structured query containing tables and optional select, filter, join, group_by, order_by, and field_mode.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous response.
